##### Project general facts

Marriott Residences is an outstanding branded residential complex made up of three elegant towers rising above a shared podium, delivering the service culture and quality standards of one of the world's most trusted hospitality names. The development offers a wonderful collection of high-end homes ranging from one to three bedrooms, complemented by a rare selection of townhouses and spectacular penthouses. Every apartment is generously proportioned and beautifully refurbished, with bright, open layouts and superb skyline views that make daily life feel effortless and uplifting.

Residents enjoy a remarkable range of hotel-grade amenities, beginning with a beautiful pool garden set on the podium level and continuing through a full spa, a spacious fitness centre with extensive cardio and strength equipment, and a dedicated kids club. The ground floor is a destination in itself, welcoming residents with a grand hotel lobby, the signature Marriott Lounge and club lounge, all-day dining and two specialty restaurants, plus a stylish café and gourmet grocer. Meeting rooms, a conference room and a board room support work and entertaining with ease, while three basement levels provide ample secure parking and back-of-house services keep everything running smoothly.

Interiors are finished with warm, refined materials — light oak joinery, herringbone timber flooring, stone countertops and soft neutral tones accented with deep blue detailing. Kitchens are fully fitted with integrated appliances, handsome cabinetry and breakfast counters, opening naturally onto bright living and dining spaces designed for both relaxing and hosting. Bedrooms feel restful and hotel-like, with upholstered feature walls, backlit headboards, built-in wardrobes and floor-to-ceiling glazing, while duplex homes add dramatic double-height living areas with sculptural staircases.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Dubai Science Park, this exceptional location is a hub for healthcare, energy, and environmental sciences, while being minutes away from business districts like Dubai Hills Business Park, Dubai Media City, and Dubai Internet City. Ideally positioned between three major highways, the development offers easy access to Dubai's iconic landmarks, with Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road just moments away.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to some of Dubai's finest schools, including Repton School within Dubai Science Park itself, Nord Anglia International School, and King's School. Golfers enjoy proximity to legendary courses like the Els Club, while world-class medical attention is available at Kings College Hospital and Mediclinic Parkview Hospital nearby.

For those seeking a residence that embodies curved elegance, innovation, and a prime Dubai address, Dubai Science Park delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of strategic connectivity, world-class amenities, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where life flows in curves, revealing endless possibilities — serene, connected and effortlessly refined.
